description: Proprietio connects ChatGPT to a property-management portfolio so property managers, owners, and accounting teams can ask operational questions in plain language. It can look up properties, units, leases, residents, vendors, work orders, and accounting reports; generate daily briefs, command-center summaries, owner updates, and risk radar; find available units; suggest open tour times without booking; triage maintenance issues without creating work orders; and spot recurring maintenance problems without returning resident contact details. All actions run through the configured Proprietio backend.

defaultPrompt: I smell gas in the kitchen — how urgent is that?
What tour times are open this week?
